notes: The mappings are limited to the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API clauses for resignation, object removal notification, and object instance identity/class lookup. The scenario verifies lookup state only after the surviving federate receives Remove Object Instance. Passing on one installed provider is test-run evidence, not a provider-independent conformance claim.

requirements.statement: The object-owning federate resigns with the standard DELETE_OBJECTS action; the scenario then observes removal at the surviving federate before checking its local lookup state.
The test waits for the surviving federate's Remove Object Instance callback after resign-time deletion before probing the removed handle.

Section 10.6 declares ObjectInstanceNotKnown for a handle not known to the federate. The test confirms class lookup succeeds before resign-time deletion and expects that exception after the removal callback.
Section 10.7 declares ObjectInstanceNotKnown when the named object is not known. After removal notification, the test expects the surviving federate's name-to-handle lookup to report that exception.
Section 10.8 declares ObjectInstanceNotKnown when the handle is not known. After removal notification, the test expects that exception for the removed handle.
